messages:
Maria G: Quick design thread — we keep getting support tickets where tenants accidentally pin models via a forwarded header. Proposal: only honor X-Model-Pin when X-Pin-Signature is present and validated by our key store. thoughts?
Sam W: yeah we've seen proxies and SDKs clobber headers. signature check seems sane. how do we handle fallback if signature missing?
Danny K: fallback rule should prefer alias resolution + version constraints instead of silent downgrade. i.e. if signature missing, apply route.match -> alias -> compatibility filter. we shouldn't let requests silently hit a totally different family.
Julie L: UX note: console needs to surface "why" a particular model was selected. operators should see: matched rule, header values (redacted), and compatibility reasons. also show telemetry sample rate.
Maria G: agree. example routing rule sketch:
```json
{
  "match": {"path": "/v1/*", "headers": {"X-Model-Pin": "present"}},
  "conditions": [{"header_signature_valid": "X-Pin-Signature"}],
  "action": {"select": "alias:customer-small-llama", "pin": true}
}
```
Sam W: small question — do we validate signature sync in gateway? that'll add latency. maybe validate async and attach a decision cookie for subsequent requests?
Danny K: prefer sync at gateway for first request to avoid misrouting. but we can cache signature result per tenant for 1m. adds ~0.5ms on p99 if optimized.
Julie L: telemetry: we should record a compact decision tuple for each request: {rule_id, matched_headers, signature_verdict, selected_model_alias, fallback_reason} with sampling. Those fields help audits and regressions.
Maria G: +1. Also quota interactions: pinned requests should count against pinned pool quota, not generic quota. need clear docs and console labels.
Sam W: ops concern: if pin points to a private on-prem model not available in region, we need auto-fallback policy that is explicit (and visible in console): e.g. fallback_to: [alias:compatible-quant, alias:cpu-safe] and record when fallback occurred.
routing-bot: config apply: routing-rule "header-safety-pin-v1" deployed to prod (canary=10%) by @Danny K at 2145679000
Julie L: small UX ask — when canarying pin rules, show per-tenant impact preview (expected matched count, top affected endpoints) and an "enforce signature" toggle.
Maria G: ok next steps: Danny to land gateway signature check + cache, Sam to add quota mapping, Julie to spec console exposures and telemetry schema. i'll open PRs and link here. :thumbsup:
Sam W: ack, will add unit tests for header edgecases.
Danny K: will prototype cache & perf numbers, ping infra if we need a new key in KMS.
Julie L: will draft console mockups and telemetry sample.
Maria G: thanks all. follow-ups in PRs. :+1:
